proposed.text: What is the primary purpose of NHMFC (National Home Mortgage Finance Corporation) in the housing finance system?

options.text: To originate new housing loans to individual borrowers, focusing on first-time homebuyers and low-income families
To regulate housing loan terms and interest rates, ensuring they remain competitive and accessible to the general public
To insure housing loans against borrower default, providing a safety net for lenders in case of financial instability
To purchase housing loans from primary lenders, returning capital so lenders can issue new loans (secondary mortgage market function)

proposed.rationale: NHMFC operates the secondary mortgage market—it buys loans that Pag-IBIG, banks, and other primary lenders have originated. This recycling mechanism replenishes lender capital, enabling continuous loan issuance. NHMFC does not directly lend to borrowers. [A]: NHMFC does not originate loans; primary lenders do. [B]: That is DHSUD and the Central Bank's role, not NHMFC's. [C]: That is not NHMFC's function (loan insurance would be a separate product). [D]: NHMFC operates the secondary mortgage market—it buys loans that Pag-IBIG, banks, and other primary lenders have originated. This recycling mechanism replenishes lender capital, enabling continuous loan issuance. NHMFC does not directly lend to borrowers.
